method: Actual combatTick. 40 job/pet pairs separately evaluated at normal99 and reborn120, in field/boss/pack scenarios, three fixed seeds. Matching uncommon character and pet gear at Lv99, IV3, no cards. Legal attribute budgets (normal196, reborn258), full paid branch skill budgets plus two free rebirth unlocks. Normal default priority; reborn priority enables buffs before new main then existing skills, no exhaustive optimization. Petland capture and economic rewards are outside frozen-progression combat scoring. HP-equivalent actual damage, prevention and effective healing; mana/gold are not damage. Scenario-normalized equal-weight composite. No class or pet-role damage coefficients.
